<entry id="M01434">
<head-word>מָכַר</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. כָּרָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to sell</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 169 (ref. to Deut. XVIII, 8) מה מָכְרוּ וכ' what have the fathers sold to one another? (Answ. the weekly turns); Succ. 56
<sup>a</sup>; Y. ib. V, end, 55
<sup>d</sup>. B. Bath. 64
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. מוֹכֵר בעין יפה מוכר the seller is presumed to sell liberally, i.e. to sell all except that which is specified as excluded; מ' בעיין רעה מ' he sells only that which is specified as sold. Ib. IV, 1 …המוכר … לא מ' וכ' if one sells …, he has not implicitly sold &c. Sot. III, 8 אין האשה מוֹכֶרֶת וכ' a woman cannot sell her daughter; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. מָכוּר; f. מְכוּרָה; 
<italic>pl</italic>. מְכוּרִים מְכוּרִין; מְכוּרוֹת. Tosef. Ab. Zar. III (IV), 18 הרי זה מ' he is sold (the sale is valid). B. Bath. IV, 3. Tosef. B. Kam. VII, 8 חביות המ' וכ' wine casks which have been sold to the shopkeeper (awaiting delivery); a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִמְכַּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be sold</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. l. c. האיש נ' … נִמְכֶּרֶת a man can be sold for his theft, but a woman cannot &c. Mekh. Mishp. s. 2; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M01436">
<head-word>מֶכֶר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> מָכַר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>sale</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 6
<sup>b</sup> במ' לא קנה if the transaction is a sale (of land), he has not acquired possession (by delivering the purchasing money as a loan). Ib. 47
<sup>a</sup> ושוין במ' and they agree in the case of a sale. Keth. XI, 4 מִכְרָהּ בטל her sale is invalid; a. fr.—V. מִמְכָּר.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M01437">
<head-word>מַכָּר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> נָכַר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>acquaintance, friend</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Gitt. III, 45
<sup>a</sup> ויש מ' לעני has the poor man a friend?, i.e., is he who separates the poor man’s tithes permitted to reserve them for a certain person?—
<plural-form>Pl. מַכָּרִים,</plural-form> constr. מַכָּרֵי. Ib, במ' כהונה וכ' the Mishnah speaks of friends of priests or Levites (to whom the owner is in the habit of giving the priestly shares); Bab. ib. 30
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. במ' לא קתני (sub. כהונה) the Mishnah does not distinctly speak of friends. Ḥull. 133
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M01439">
<head-word>מְכֵרוֹת</head-word>
<pos> f. pl.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (מָכַר) 
<italic>sales</italic>, trnsf.
<pos> m.</pos> (cmp. לְקוּחוֹת) 
<italic>seller</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 98 (ref. to Gen. XLIX, 6 מְכֵרֹת־) for whom are those weapons fit? למְכֵרוֹתֵיהֶן וכ' to their seller, to Esau who sold the birth-right (to their father).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (= מְכֹרוֹת, fr. נָכַר, cmp. מַכָּר) 
<italic>friendship, neighborhood, neighbors</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Vayḥi 9; Gen. R. s. 99 (ref. to Gen. l. c.) וי"א מכרותיהם מגורותיהם וכ' (ed. Wil. מְכוֹר') and some say 
<italic>m’kherothehem</italic>, means their neighborhoods (ed. Wil.: and some say, read it 
<italic>m’khorothehen</italic>) as we read (Ez. XVI, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition />
<notes> &c.—V. 
<xref rid="M01383">מְכֵירִין</xref></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M01442">
<head-word>מַכְשִׁיר</head-word>
<head-word> , </head-word>
<head-word>מַכְשִׁירִין</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (כָּשֵׁר) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>preparatory means, preliminary acts</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 7
<sup>b</sup> מַכְשִׁירֵי אוכל נפש acts preliminary to the preparation of food (as grinding the slaughtering knife &c.). Ib. הוא ולא מַכְשִׁירָיו it says (Ex. XII, 16) ‘that’ (alone may be done), but not its preliminaries. Ib. מ' שאפשר וכ' acts which might have been done a day before. Erub. 102
<sup>b</sup>, sq. מ' מצוה requirements of a religious act (to be performed on the Sabbath, v. דָּחָה). Sabb. 136
<sup>a</sup> מ' מילה requirements for circumcision. Tosef. Pes. V, 1; Y. Sabb. XIX, 17
<sup>a</sup> top; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>Makhshirin</italic> (things which make an object fit for levitical uncleanness), name of a 
<pgbrk id="pg785" />treatise of the Mishnah and Tosefta, of the Order of Tohăroth.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></entry>

<plural-form>Pl. מְכַשְּׁפִים</plural-form>. Tanḥ. Vaëra 3. Snh. 67
<sup>b</sup> אוב … בכלל מ' היו

<italic>Yidʿoni</italic> are included in the law against sorcerers; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup> אמרו לפני … מלכיות שתַּמְלִיכוּנִי עליכם recite before me verses of homage (v. מַלְכוּת), in order that you may declare me your ruler; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M01613">
<head-word>מָלַק</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to pinch</italic> a bird’s neck with the finger nail.</definition>
<notes> Zeb. VI, 5; Ib. VII, 5; a. fr.—Part. pass. מָלוּק; f. מְלוּקָה, 
<plural-form>pl. מְלוּקוֹת</plural-form>. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., Par. 9, ch. XI מְלוּקַת רשות a bird that has been pinched for a profane purpose, opp. מ' מציה. Ib. מלוקית ישראל birds pinched by Israelites (not for sacrificial purposes), opp. מ' כהנים.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִמְלַק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be killed by pinching</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. II, 5
<sup>a</sup> bot. משנִמְלְקָה after the pinching has been performed. Ab. d’R. N. ch. I כמה עופות נִמְלְקוּ עליך how many birds have been pinched for thee (the altar)!; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
